Body.Content:
Customers can now configure the allowable increment for time entry durations to ensure that all logged time adheres to their organization’s time-tracking policies. When enabled, you can only create or modify time entries whose duration is a multiple of the configured value (for example, 15 minutes, or 1 hour), helping prevent erroneous or non-compliant time entries from being recorded.

Business Value:

Customers can now ensure that time entry duration is always a multiple of a value set by them, preventing erroneous time entries from being logged.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

GA date: November CY2026
